# Hotel K2

> Hotel K2 is a hotel in Chakradharpur, West Singhbhum, Jharkhand, located near Chakradharpur Railway Station at Etwari Bazar, Station Link Road. It offers AC rooms with free Wi-Fi, TV, geyser and power backup, plus 24-hour room service, 24-hour front desk, banquet hall, conference hall, catering, car rental and self-drive scooty.

Key details:

- Name: Hotel K2
- Type: Hotel / accommodation
- Location: Chakradharpur, West Singhbhum, Jharkhand, India
- Address: K2 Complex, Etwari Bazar, Station Link Road, near Carmel School, Chakradharpur, West Singhbhum, Jharkhand 833102, India
- Phone: +91 8709490824, +91 9123490131
- Email: hotelk2.ckp@gmail.com
- Check-in: 12:00 — Check-out: 11:00
- Currency: INR
- Booking: https://bookone.io/Hotel-K2-Chakradharpur?bookingEngine=true
- Nearby: Chakradharpur Railway Station, Etwari Bazar market, Carmel School, DRM Office
